0022600217.text: The Pacers host the Wizards at 3-7 overall and 0-5 at home, with a 3-7 record over their last ten games and a one-game losing streak, placing them third in the Central, four games back, and 11th in the East. Washington enters at 4-7, having dropped four straight, and sits fourth in the Southeast, 2.5 games back, and 10th in the East. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain, averaging 21.8 points per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee), and Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), while Washington is without Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), with Bilal Coulibaly listed as day-to-day with a hand injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Pacers lost 1-3 in the season series, including a 131-118 loss in Washington on February 20, 2026.
